items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: Someone would write the score and Tizal would abstract it.

ctx.x: Well, no, there might be five main arrangers and maybe one guy would only do two.

Well, and then you might have the thing that existed in Duke's band. Someone would write the score and Tizal would abstract it. We didn't have anything like this. The guy would write the arrangement. He would write his score and he would write each individual part for each musician.
So you didn't have any copies or anything like that? No copies. The guy would do the whole work from top to bottom. That's right. That must have had some morale in the band. Beautiful. Beautiful.
